newsitem.title: UK: UK Labour calls pension plans "chilling prospect".
newsitem.headline: UK Labour calls pension plans "chilling prospect".

text.p: The government's sweeping pension reform proposals presage the end of state pensions and will impose big tax rises in disguise, Harriet Harman, the social security spokeswoman of the main opposition Labour party, said on Wednesday.
She said Labour would look carefully at the proposals, outlined earlier by Prime Minister John major.
"But at first sight they present a chilling prospect for hard-working families. The proposals mean the end of state pensions," Harman said in a statement.
"They will impose huge, disguised tax increases for everyone, lasting well into the next century. And they will provide no guarantee of security in retirement," she added.
Harman said the proposals would mean massive unfairness in future pensions and demonstrate that the Conservatives could not be trusted on pensions.
